subject: Shoreline MAP: evidence runbook, DPA redline, and retention alignment
messages:
From: Laura Davies <ldavies@shorelineai.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@shorelineai.com
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Shoreline MAP: evidence and retention questions

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Shoreline is aligned on proceeding with an accelerated evaluation. Legal and Security have a couple of gating items before we can commit to the final MAP and sign the DPA: 

- SOC 2: we need a redacted SOC 2 Type II (or a SOC 2 summary) and a short explanation of data segmentation between hosted and private deployments.
- SIG/CAIQ: we prefer a completed CAIQ spreadsheet for our security review.
- DPA: our legal team will submit a redline (attached initial notes) — we need to understand Redwood's position on data residency and retention.
- Retention: Shoreline requires retention tiers per data type (product data, audit logs, backups) and a proposed default retention window.

Can you share a short MAP runbook with acceptance gates and an estimated close timeline? We are targeting go/no-go for procurement by 2026-11-12.

Appreciate a single consolidated response that we can route internally.

Best,
Laura Davies
Director, Security & Compliance
Shoreline AI

--Attachment: shoreline_map_draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Laura Davies <ldavies@shorelineai.com>
Cc: contracts@shorelineai.com, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Shoreline MAP: evidence and retention questions

Laura — thanks for the clear list. I've pulled together the initial materials and a proposed MAP sprint. Attachments: Redwood_SOC2-summary.pdf (summary + how we redact customer identifiers), SIG-CAIQ-completed.xlsx (completed where applicable), DPA-redline_v2.docx (our annotated response), and a draft MAP-timeline.xlsx showing milestones.

Quick summary and proposed approach:
- SOC 2: we can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and a short segregation diagram. Delivery by 2026-11-02.
- SIG/CAIQ: completed CAIQ attached; items flagged for third-party controls are noted — security will be available for an 1-hour walkthrough.
- DPA & retention: our standard DPA (redline attached) proposes default retention windows of 5 years for production data, 1 year for short-term caches, and 7 years for audit/logs where required by regulation. We can negotiate carveouts for e-discovery / legal holds.
- Data residency: Hosted API is multi-region; for Shoreline's requirements we recommend Redwood Private (VPC) or Dedicated with region pinning. We outline KMS options (customer-managed keys supported via KMS/HSM).
- Timeline: propose the following milestones — evidence delivery (SOC2/CAIQ) by 2026-11-02; DPA final redline by 2026-11-04; procurement signature target 2026-11-12; onboarding kickoff week of 2026-11-15.

Action items for Shoreline: please confirm which data residency region you need (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and whether you require customer-managed keys. Once confirmed we will update the MAP timeline and deliver the security walkthrough invite.

I'll follow up internally to coordinate legal and retention language.

Regards,
Michael Grant
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

--Attachments: Redwood_SOC2-summary.pdf (application/pdf); SIG-CAIQ-completed.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet); DPA-redline_v2.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document); MAP-timeline.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Shoreline MAP — who owns what? (SOC2 / DPA / retention)

Jordan / Kim — looping you on Shoreline (DL-93471). They want a compact MAP and have procurement goals the week of 11/12. Please see my notes from the external thread (SOC2 + CAIQ + DPA redline attached).

Proposed split:
- Kimberly: lead on DPA negotiation and retention carveouts; review DPA-redline_v2 and provide final language by COB 2026-11-02.
- Jordan: confirm operational feasibility for retention windows and customer-managed KMS; note any service-level changes needed for region pinning.
- Michael (me): coordinate delivery of SOC2 summary and run the security walkthrough; I'll own the MAP timeline updates and external comms.

Key constraints to call out to Shoreline:
- If Shoreline requires region-locked residency in multiple regions we may recommend Dedicated capacity commitments (cost impact).
- Retention exceptions for legal holds will need SOC/infra signoff if >7 years.

Please reply with confirmations and any redlines to the suggested timeline.

Thanks,
Michael

--Quoted attachments: DPA-redline_v2.docx, MAP-timeline.xlsx
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: Shoreline MAP — who owns what? (SOC2 / DPA / retention)

Thanks Michael. I'll take the DPA. Initial thoughts after a quick pass:

- Retention windows: Redwood's standard windows (5y product, 1y cache, 7y logs) are defensible. Suggest we add explicit language for: data subject requests, regulatory holds, and e-discovery exceptions.
- Data residency language: confirm we will offer region pinning for Dedicated/Private; for Hosted we offer best-effort region routing with contractual commitments only for Dedicated/Private.
- Security evidence: SOC2 summary + CAIQ is fine for procurement review; if Shoreline requests raw evidence we should require an NDA/certified request process.

I'll produce a DPA redline with suggested retention clauses by EOD 2026-11-04. If Jordan can confirm any technical constraints on retention enforcement (e.g., immutable logs / archive retention), I will incorporate a practical SLA window.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Laura Davies <ldavies@shorelineai.com>
Cc: contracts@shorelineai.com, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 05 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Shoreline MAP: evidence runbook, DPA redline, and retention alignment

Laura — quick consolidation and next steps.

What we've attached and what we'll deliver:
- SOC2: Redwood_SOC2-summary.pdf (redacted Type II summary). Full report available under NDA; delivery complete 2026-11-02.
- CAIQ: SIG-CAIQ-completed.xlsx we filled in sections applicable to our platform; we'll host a 60-minute walkthrough on 2026-11-03 (invite to follow).
- DPA: DPA-redline_v2.docx (our annotated response). Kimberly will provide a legal redline by 2026-11-04 and propose final language for retention carveouts.
- MAP: MAP-timeline.xlsx shows acceptance gates. Current procurement target remains 2026-11-12 with onboarding kickoff the week of 2026-11-15.

Decisions we need from Shoreline:
- Confirm data residency preference (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — reply by 2026-11-06 to keep timeline.
- Confirm whether you require customer-managed KMS (yes/no).

If both are confirmed, we will update the MAP and route the final DPA back to your contracts alias for signature.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out quickly.

Michael Grant
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
